modmenu.descriptionTranslation.vulkanplu: High-performance companion optimization mod for VulkanMod.
vulkanplus.options.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all Vulkan Plus optimizations globally.
vulkanplus.options.preset.tooltip: Applies curated configuration profiles: Fast (maximum FPS), Balanced (recommended), or Extreme (aggressive culling).
vulkanplus.options.showFps.tooltip: Displays a real-time frames-per-second counter in the top-left corner of the screen.
vulkanplus.options.showDiagnosticsHud.to: Displays technical rendering statistics, pipeline states, and memory metrics on screen (F8).
vulkanplus.options.opaqueLeaves.tooltip: Renders leaf blocks as solid textures and culls hidden inner geometry for a substantial framerate boost in forests.
vulkanplus.options.smartLeaves.tooltip: Culls internal leaf faces occluded by adjacent leaves while preserving transparent foliage.
vulkanplus.options.bufferPooling.tooltip: Reuses pre-allocated Vulkan vertex and staging buffers to reduce memory allocation overhead and frame drops.
vulkanplus.options.descriptorCaching.too: Caches descriptor sets to eliminate redundant bind calls to the GPU driver.
vulkanplus.options.psoCache.tooltip: Caches compiled Vulkan Pipeline State Objects to disk to mitigate shader compilation micro-stutters.
vulkanplus.options.reverseZ.tooltip: Reverses depth buffer coordinates to increase floating-point precision and prevent distant z-fighting.
vulkanplus.options.swapchainTuning.toolt: Optimizes swapchain presentation timings to lower display latency and maintain smooth frame pacing.
vulkanplus.options.presentMode.tooltip: Vulkan presentation sync mode: Mailbox (tear-free low latency), FIFO (vsync), or Immediate (uncapped low latency).
vulkanplus.options.moreCulling.tooltip: Skips rendering entities and block entities outside the camera view frustum or behind terrain.
vulkanplus.options.blockEntityCulling.to: Omits drawing chests, signs, hoppers, and banners that are outside the camera frustum.
Skips rendering block entities when their faces are entirely hidden behind solid opaque blocks.
vulkanplus.options.chestProtection.toolt: Prevents block entity culling on chests near the crosshair to avoid pop-in while interacting.
vulkanplus.options.beaconBeamCulling.too: Culls vertical beacon beam segments that extend beyond the camera view frustum.
vulkanplus.options.beaconProtection.tool: Keeps beacon base structures visible when the player is within range of an active beacon.
vulkanplus.options.extraGlassCulling.too: Culls obscured faces of glass blocks and stained glass panes connecting to adjacent solid blocks.
vulkanplus.options.particleCulling.toolt: Omits rendering particles that are obscured by solid walls or exceed distance thresholds.
vulkanplus.options.fastItemFrames.toolti: Applies directional backface and frustum culling to item frames, speeding up rendering in storage areas.
vulkanplus.options.itemFrameBlockOcclusi: Culls item frames when the surface they are placed against is occluded by adjacent blocks.
vulkanplus.options.threadPriority.toolti: Raises render thread priority and adjusts background worker priorities to prevent frame pacing stutters.
vulkanplus.options.fastMath.tooltip: Utilizes optimized mathematical functions for rendering transformations and vector computations.
vulkanplus.options.fastRandom.tooltip: Replaces standard RNG with a high-performance pseudo-random generator for particle effects.
vulkanplus.options.matrixPooling.tooltip: Reuses Matrix4f transformation objects in the render pipeline to reduce garbage collection pressure.
